description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Colombo Port City (Apartment Ownership) Regulations No.06 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Investment Promotion under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. The content focuses on establishing legal and regulatory frameworks for apartment ownership, condominium management, escrow accounts, and administrative procedures within the Colombo Port City. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
